summary: The notebook holds two notes: a gradient-descent course note and a reviewed reading note on the Transformer paper.

areas.label: Machine Learning
areas.coverage: One foundations note covering gradient descent, learning-rate failure modes, and a worked quadratic example.
areas.gap: No notes yet on refinements like momentum or Adam, which the gradient-descent note sets up.

areas.label: Deep Learning
areas.coverage: A must-read note on 'Attention Is All You Need' covering self-attention, multi-head design, and WMT BLEU results.
areas.gap: The note flags quadratic cost and positional encodings, but no notes on efficient attention or serving exist.
